note: VCF Automation ships no OpenAPI/Swagger document in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0). Every field in docs/contract.json was transcribed by hand from the human-readable xAPIs reference pages listed below. Each entry names the page that was read, the contract operation it backs, and the date the page was fetched.

pages.title: Org Management - VM Apps Org
pages.documents: index of the VCF Automation VM Apps Org API families; used to locate the Identity and Deployment references

pages.title: Login Controller APIs | VM Apps Org - Identity
pages.documents: operation list for the Login Controller

pages.title: Login Oauth | VM Apps Org - Identity 9.1
pages.documents: POST /csp/gateway/am/api/login/oauth - request body fields grant_type (required), state (required), refresh_token, code, redirect_uri, client_id, client_secret, scope, orgId; response fields scope, access_token, refresh_token, id_token, token_type, expires_in

pages.title: Authentication Controller APIs | VM Apps Org - Identity 9.1
pages.documents: cross-check of the token-issuing operations; records that /csp/gateway/am/api/auth/api-tokens/authorize returns the same access_token / refresh_token / expires_in envelope and that the reference points readers at /oidc/oauth2/token as the successor endpoint

pages.title: REST API Index | VM Apps Org - Identity 9.1
pages.documents: confirms that /oidc/oauth2/token has no operation page of its own in this reference; the only token operations with published request/response schemas are the CSP gateway ones

pages.title: Deployments APIs | VM Apps Org - Deployment 9.1
pages.documents: operation list for the Deployments family

pages.title: Get Deployments | VM Apps Org - Deployment 9.1
pages.documents: GET /deployment/api/deployments - query parameters page (default 0), size (default 20), sort (default createdAt,DESC) and filters; paginated response envelope content, empty, first, last, number, numberOfElements, pageable, size, sort, totalElements, totalPages

pages.title: Patch Deployment | VM Apps Org - Deployment 9.1
pages.documents: PATCH /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId} - DeploymentUpdate body with three optional fields name (minLength 1, maxLength 900), description (maxLength 2000), iconId (uuid); returns the updated Deployment

pages.title: Get Deployment By Id | VM Apps Org - Deployment 9.1
pages.documents: documented status codes for the Deployment resource, including 401 Unauthorized; used to model the expired-token response

pages.title: Authentication | VM Apps Org - Deployment 9.1
pages.documents: security scheme bearerAuth: type http, scheme bearer, bearerFormat JWT, carried in the Authorization header
